This is a monorepo for a Web3 dApp. The frontend is a Next.js app (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) in the root, and smart contracts are in the `contracts` folder using Hardhat and OpenZeppelin. The dApp allows users to mint an ERC-20 token and uses Privy for wallet connection. Prioritize best practices for Web3, contract security, and modern React/Next.js patterns.
